name: Bounding Hounds
disable: DC 36 Nature check (expert) to calm each hound, or DC 38 Occultism check (master) to banish each hound
routine: (9 actions) The trap loses 3 actions each round for each hound disabled. Each hound uses three actions to Stride 40 feet after creatures in the room, passing through corporeal creatures during this movement if possible. Each creature the hound moves through during its movement takes 2d8 + 7 void damage (DC 37 Reflex save negates). A creature can only be damaged by each hound once each round, no matter how many times the hound moves through their space.

items.name: Bay
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the area

---
Effect The hounds manifest and bay loudly, dealing 3d10 + 16 sonic damage to all creatures within 30 feet of the hounds (DC 33 basic Fortitude save). On a failed check, a creature is additionally Frightened 2. The trap then rolls initiative.

text: Three phantom hounds chase down intruders, damaging any they pass through.
